Transfer Terms, Conditions & Restrictions
  1. One Time Only: Package conversion is a one-time privilege and cannot be reversed once approved.
  2. Validity Period: Transfer is permitted only within the validity period of the original package.
  3. Remaining Sessions Only: Only unused balance sessions are transferred. Consumed sessions are non-transferable.
  4. No Cash Refund: No refund, credit note, partial refund, or monetary compensation is permitted.
  5. Medical Suitability: The transferee confirms they are medically fit to receive the transferred treatment.
  6. Pricing: Transferred sessions will be executed at prices applicable at the original purchase.
  7. Management Approval: Management approval is mandatory for package conversion.
